text: The project features a national framework for risk-sensitive land use planning (RSLUP), establishment of a National Disaster Training Academy, digitized bundled insurance, and matched municipal/private investments. It emphasizes gender and social inclusion, targeting 50% participation of women and excluded groups in capacity building. The project also supports community-based DRR construction, humanitarian open spaces, and nature-based solutions like planting native saplings for slope stabilization.

metadata.solution_name: USAID’s Tayar Nepal – Improved Disaster Risk Management Project (Tayar Nepal)
